mode.description: Fan-out mode. 'parallel': run the configured 'graph_id' flow concurrently once per item in 'items' and wait for all of them to finish (barrier), returning results in input order. 'pipeline': run the configured ordered 'graph_ids' flows in sequence, feeding each stage's output as the next stage's input, and return the final output.

items.description: Parallel mode only. A list of JSON objects — one per concurrent sub-flow run — each object is the 'variables' payload passed into that run of the configured 'graph_id' flow. Capped at 'max_items' entries per call.

input.description: Pipeline mode only. The JSON object passed as the input/variables to the first stage in 'graph_ids'. Each subsequent stage receives the previous stage's output as its input.

graph_id.description: Parallel mode only. ID of the saved flow (graph) to run once per item in 'items'. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never chooses which flow to call.

graph_ids.description: Pipeline mode only. Ordered list of saved flow (graph) IDs — stage 1 runs first with 'input', stage 2 receives stage 1's output as its input, and so on. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent.

api_key.description: EpicStaff API key used to authenticate the run-session / session-status calls (sent as the X-Api-Key header). Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent.

api_base_url.description: Base URL of the EpicStaff Django REST API, e.g. http://djangoapp:8000/api. Optional — if unset, falls back to the DJANGO_API_URL environment variable, then to http://djangoapp:8000/api.

poll_timeout_s.description: Maximum seconds to wait for each individual sub-flow run to finish before giving up. Optional, default 300.

max_items.description: Optional cap on the number of parallel items (or pipeline stages) allowed in a single call. Default 10. In parallel mode, extra items beyond the cap are truncated with a warning; in pipeline mode, exceeding the cap is rejected outright.

max_workers.description: Optional cap on the number of sub-flows run concurrently in parallel mode. Default 4. Ignored in pipeline mode, where stages always run strictly sequentially.
